// Test-owned fixture of tests/admin_audit_attribution_test.cjs (not product code): the failure classes of Astra
// S7-U3a-AUDIT-SPEC-R-001 F01-F03 and of the verdict, one case each; F03 as amended by S7-U3a-AUDIT-SPEC-B-R-001 (the
// INSERT … SELECT and WITH statements of its G2 form are supported writes in sql-positions.ts; the f03-g2-* cases are the
// variants outside G2 and the WITH fragments whose source is not fixed). Every case is a TypeScript module of its own, put next
// to the baseline fixture (baseline.ts, actions.ts, forward.ts) as api/src/syn-fixture/case-<name>.ts; with it the gate must
// fail on exactly the class its header names (and its entries) and on nothing else, and the case's lines must give exactly
// the candidates they mark (`// expect:` as in baseline.ts). The header:
//   // ==== case: <name> | verdict: <class> [entries] [| table: +row <action> | table: +wildcard <stem>] ====
// A `table:` part adds a row or a wildcard to contract.json for that case only. Text before the first header is this note.

// ==== case: f01-computed-key-on-a-client | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
export async function run(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, body: any) {
  await tx[body.log].create({ data: { action: 'syn.allowed' } }); // expect: unresolved a member of a client value by a key the program does not fix
}

// ==== case: f01-computed-key-on-a-client-a-helper-receives | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
function member(db: any, key: string) {
  return db[key]; // expect: unresolved a member of a client value by a key the program does not fix
}
export async function run(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, body: any) {
  await member(tx, body.log).create({ data: { action: 'syn.allowed' } });
}

// ==== case: f01-computed-key-on-a-client-default-parameter | verdict: unresolved ====
import { SynPrisma } from './baseline';
export class SynHolder {
  constructor(private prisma: SynPrisma) {}
  read(key: string, db: any = this.prisma) {
    return db[key]; // expect: unresolved a member of a client value by a key the program does not fix
  }
}

// ==== case: f02-a-helper-with-an-unknown-call | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
export class SynHelper {
  private audit(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, action: string) {
    return tx.auditLog.create({ data: { action } }); // expect: unresolved `body.kind` is a property the program does not fix
  }
  async run(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, body: any) {
    await this.audit(tx, 'syn.allowed');
    await this.audit(tx, body.kind);
  }
}

// ==== case: f02-a-helper-handed-on | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
export class SynHelper {
  private writers: unknown[] = [];
  private handed(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, action: string) {
    return tx.auditLog.create({ data: { action } }); // expect: unresolved which is handed on at
  }
  async run(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient) {
    this.writers.push(this.handed);
    await this.handed(tx, 'syn.allowed');
  }
}

// ==== case: f02-a-public-method-parameter | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
export class SynPublic {
  async write(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, action: string) {
    await tx.auditLog.create({ data: { action } }); // expect: unresolved which callers outside this program can call
  }
  async run(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient) { await this.write(tx, 'syn.allowed'); }
}

// ==== case: f02-a-decorated-private-method-parameter | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
const Hook = (): MethodDecorator => () => undefined;
export class SynDecorated {
  @Hook() private hooked(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, action: string) {
    return tx.auditLog.create({ data: { action } }); // expect: unresolved which callers outside this program can call
  }
  async run(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient) { await this.hooked(tx, 'syn.allowed'); }
}

// ==== case: f02-a-guard-that-does-not-exit | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
export async function run(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, body: any) {
  const kind = body.kind;
  if (!['syn.allowed'].includes(kind)) console.warn('SYN unknown kind');

}

// ==== case: f02-a-guard-after-the-write | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
export async function run(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, body: any) {
  const kind = body.kind;
  await tx.auditLog.create({ data: { action: kind } }); // expect: unresolved `body.kind` is a property the program does not fix
  if (!['syn.allowed'].includes(kind)) throw new Error('SYN unknown kind');
}

// ==== case: f02-a-guard-joined-by-and | verdict: unresolved ====

  if (!['syn.allowed'].includes(kind) && body.strict) throw new Error('SYN unknown kind');

}

// ==== case: f02-a-guarded-binding-changed-before-the-write | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
export async function run(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, body: any) {
  let kind = body.kind;
  if (!['syn.allowed'].includes(kind)) throw new Error('SYN unknown kind');
  kind = body.other;
  await tx.auditLog.create({ data: { action: kind } }); // expect: unresolved `body.kind` is a property the program does not fix
}

export async function run(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, actor: string, uid: string) {
  await tx.$executeRaw`INSERT INTO "AuditLog" (actor, action, target) VALUES (${actor}, 'syn.' || 'allowed', ${uid})`; // expect: unresolved the action value is not one SQL string or one interpolation
}

// ==== case: f03-an-sql-text-no-raw-call-runs | verdict: unresolved ====
export const SQL = 'INSERT INTO "AuditLog" (actor, action, target) VALUES ($1, $2, $3)'; // expect: unresolved names AuditLog but is not the fixed SQL of a raw call

// ==== case: f03-an-unsafe-call-with-parameters | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
export async function run(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, actor: string, uid: string) {
  await tx.$executeRawUnsafe( // expect: unresolved its SQL is not one fixed text of the program
    'INSERT INTO "AuditLog" (actor, action, target) VALUES ($1, $2, $3)', // expect: unresolved names AuditLog but is not the fixed SQL of a raw call
    actor, 'syn.allowed', uid);
}

}

}

// ==== case: f03-g2-a-with-fragment-of-a-public-method | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
export class SynPublic {
  async linked(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, actor: string, selector: Prisma.Sql) {
    await tx.$executeRaw`WITH s AS (SELECT t.uid FROM "StudyState" t WHERE ${selector}) INSERT INTO "AuditLog" (actor, action, target) SELECT ${actor}, 'syn.allowed', uid FROM s`; // expect: unresolved which callers outside this program can call
  }
}

// ==== case: f03-g2-a-with-fragment-with-one-unfixed-path | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
export class SynPaths {
  private async linked(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, actor: string, selector: Prisma.Sql) {
    await tx.$executeRaw`WITH s AS (SELECT t.uid FROM "StudyState" t WHERE ${selector}) INSERT INTO "AuditLog" (actor, action, target) SELECT ${actor}, 'syn.allowed', uid FROM s`; // expect: unresolved `body.where` is not a Prisma.sql text
  }
  async fixed(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, actor: string, uid: string) { await this.linked(tx, actor, Prisma.sql`t.uid = ${uid}::text`); }
  async unfixed(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, actor: string, body: any) { await this.linked(tx, actor, body.where); }
}

// ==== case: f03-g2-a-with-fragment-of-another-shape | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
export class SynShape {
  private async linked(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, actor: string, selector: Prisma.Sql) {
    await tx.$executeRaw`WITH s AS (SELECT t.uid FROM "StudyState" t WHERE ${selector}) INSERT INTO "AuditLog" (actor, action, target) SELECT ${actor}, 'syn.allowed', uid FROM s`; // expect: unresolved is not the predicate
  }
  async escape(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, actor: string) { await this.linked(tx, actor, Prisma.sql`true), extra AS (SELECT 1`); }
}

// ==== case: f03-g2-a-with-fragment-whose-value-is-a-fragment | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
export class SynInner {
  private async linked(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, actor: string, selector: Prisma.Sql) {
    await tx.$executeRaw`WITH s AS (SELECT t.uid FROM "StudyState" t WHERE ${selector}) INSERT INTO "AuditLog" (actor, action, target) SELECT ${actor}, 'syn.allowed', uid FROM s`; // expect: unresolved is not shown to be a value
  }
  async inner(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, actor: string) { await this.linked(tx, actor, Prisma.sql`t.uid = ${Prisma.raw('uid')}::text`); }
}

// ==== case: f03-g2-a-with-fragment-in-a-cycle | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
export class SynCycle {
  private async linked(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, actor: string, selector: Prisma.Sql, again: boolean) {
    if (again) await this.relay(tx, actor, selector);
    await tx.$executeRaw`WITH s AS (SELECT t.uid FROM "StudyState" t WHERE ${selector}) INSERT INTO "AuditLog" (actor, action, target) SELECT ${actor}, 'syn.allowed', uid FROM s`; // expect: unresolved is reached again
  }
  private async relay(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, actor: string, selector: Prisma.Sql) { await this.linked(tx, actor, selector, false); }
  async start(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, actor: string, uid: string) { await this.linked(tx, actor, Prisma.sql`t.uid = ${uid}::text`, true); }
}

// ==== case: f03-g2-a-with-fragment-changed-before-use | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
export class SynChanged {
  private async linked(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, actor: string, selector: Prisma.Sql, body: any) {
    if (body.wide) selector = body.where;
    await tx.$executeRaw`WITH s AS (SELECT t.uid FROM "StudyState" t WHERE ${selector}) INSERT INTO "AuditLog" (actor, action, target) SELECT ${actor}, 'syn.allowed', uid FROM s`; // expect: unresolved is changed
  }
  async start(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, actor: string, uid: string, body: any) { await this.linked(tx, actor, Prisma.sql`t.uid = ${uid}::text`, body); }
}

// ==== case: verdict-unlisted-through-a-constant-delegate-key | verdict: unlisted syn.unlisted ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
const LOG = 'auditLog';
export async function run(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient) {
  await tx[LOG].create({ data: { action: 'syn.unlisted' } }); // expect: resolved syn.unlisted
}

// ==== case: verdict-a-dynamic-suffix-no-wildcard-covers | verdict: uncovered_prefixes syn.other. ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
export async function run(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, body: any) {
  await tx.auditLog.create({ data: { action: 'syn.other.' + body.kind } }); // expect: resolved prefix:syn.other.
}
